item.title: Car-truck collision on the A2, Rega responds
item.description: A car and a truck involved on Friday on the A2 in Coldrerio: three injured, two apparently seriously injured. Temporary closure between Mendrisio and Chiasso.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Accident on the A2 in Coldrerio at around 15:45 - A car and a truck involved - Three injured, two apparently seriously - A2 closed between Mendrisio and Chiasso
## Key facts - What: collision between a car and a truck - When: Friday afternoon, around 15:45 - Where: A2 southbound, in the Coldrerio area - Responders: SAM, REGA, firefighters from the Mendrisiotto rescue center and Cantonal Police - Traffic: closure between Mendrisio and Chiasso, then one lane - Tally: three injured, two apparently seriously
### The initial tally A serious accident occurred on Friday afternoon, around 15:45, on the A2 motorway southbound, in the Coldrerio area. The first information gathered reports the involvement of a car and a truck.
For reasons yet to be established, the car is said to have collided with the rear of the heavy vehicle. The circumstances are therefore still described in preliminary terms, without an explanation of the reasons that led to the crash.
SAM rescuers, a REGA helicopter, firefighters from the Mendrisiotto rescue center and Cantonal Police responded at the scene. The need to allow rescue operations and the helicopter to land led to the temporary closure of the motorway.
The section affected by the closure was the one between Mendrisio and Chiasso. Subsequently, traffic was channeled into a single lane. The source also reports an initial tally of three injured people, two of whom were apparently seriously injured. This figure too is reported on the basis of the first information available.
The sequence described is therefore that of an accident occurring on the A2 southbound route, followed by the arrival of emergency services, the temporary closure and the subsequent management of traffic on a single lane. The cause of the crash remains to be established. ## Traffic conditions during rescue operations ### The move to one lane The management of the motorway is the main operational development reported by the source. To allow rescue operations and the helicopter's landing, the A2 was temporarily closed between Mendrisio and Chiasso. The measure therefore concerns a specific stretch of the motorway, while the accident was located in the territory of Coldrerio and in the southbound direction.
| Stage | Situation indicated by the source | | --- | --- | | Rescue and landing operations | A2 temporarily closed between Mendrisio and Chiasso | | Subsequently | Traffic routed onto a single lane |
The text distinguishes two stages of the traffic situation: first, the closure related to the rescue operations and landing, then the routing of traffic onto a single lane. The sequence therefore links the closure to the operations indicated and reports the subsequent move to one lane.
Alongside this traffic development, the source lists the services that responded: the SAM rescuers, the REGA helicopter, the firefighters from the Mendrisiotto rescue center and the Cantonal Police. The initial toll remains three injured people, two of whom were apparently seriously injured. Information about the collision and the condition of those injured is presented as initial information, while the traffic situation is described first through the temporary closure and then through traffic being routed onto a single lane. ## The circumstances remain to be established ### Still preliminary information The source leaves the central point of the reconstruction open: the causes of the accident have yet to be established. The available information describes the car as having collided with the rear of the heavy vehicle, but the wording used remains tied to the first reports collected. The reported sequence of events is not accompanied by an explanation of the causes.
The toll of the people involved is also presented as provisional. The initial reports speak of three injured people; two of them were reportedly in apparently serious condition. This figure should be read together with the qualification attached to it by the source, without turning the initial assessment into a definitive outcome.
As for traffic, the reported development consists of the transition from the temporary closure of the A2 between Mendrisio and Chiasso to the routing of traffic onto a single lane. The closure had been ordered to allow rescue operations and the landing of the REGA helicopter. The accident location remains the A2 in the southbound direction, in the territory of Coldrerio.
The source thus sets out the picture of what followed: the cause of the collision remains to be established, the toll is still tied to the initial information and the traffic situation has shifted from a temporary closure to a single lane. These are the developments reported for the accident.

item.title: Varese: 70 kg of drugs in camper, arrests
item.description: The Guardia di Finanza stops a Spanish camper van: 19 kg of cocaine, 49 of marijuana seized, and a dachshund entrusted to a family.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - More than 70 kilos of drugs seized - Two Spaniards and one Italian arrested - The shipment would have yielded more than 5 million euros - Operation in the wooded areas of the province of Varese
## Key facts - What → more than 70 kilos of drugs - Where → wooded areas of the province of Varese - Who → two 55-year-old Spaniards and a 34-year-old Italian - Money → 6.600 euros - Proceeds from drug dealing → more than five million euros
### Observation of the convoy More than 70 kilos of drugs were seized in the wooded areas of the province of Varese, where the Guardia di Finanza arrested three people. The operation was carried out by the Varese Provincial Command of the Guardia di Finanza as part of economic checks in the area.
Those stopped were a couple of 55-year-old Spanish citizens and a 34-year-old Italian man, resident in the province of Varese. The two Spaniards were traveling in a camper van with a Spanish license plate, while the Fiat 500 following the vehicle was driven by the Italian. Watson, a small fawn Brittany dachshund, was also in the camper.
During one of their routine patrols, the Guardia di Finanza officers of the Varese Economic and Financial Police Unit noticed the camper van moving slowly toward the wooded areas of the province, turning onto a dead-end dirt road. These are areas known for drug dealing. At close distance behind the vehicle, the Fiat 500 was traveling.
The route of the two vehicles, which were proceeding in convoy, aroused the officers' suspicions. The patrol maintained its distance and requested the intervention of another support unit. In the meantime, the officers hid among the dense vegetation to verify the occupants' intentions.
The convoy reached a clearing at the foot of the woods. After looking around, the occupants of the camper van unloaded a first large duffel bag and placed it in the trunk of the Fiat 500. The car was driven by the Italian, the intended recipient of the drugs.
Believing that a transfer of drugs was taking place and after reinforcements arrived, the officers intervened. The people present were detained, and numerous cocaine bricks were found in the duffel bag just loaded into the small car, bearing the distinctive effigy of the hero Superman. The operation led to the arrest of the three individuals, and the investigation was extended to the camper van and the Italian's home. ### The substances and objects found The seizure included an assortment of different substances. The recovered material included 19 kilograms of cocaine, 49 kilograms of marijuana and 1,9 kilograms of hashish. These quantities were joined by 72 grams of heroin, 233 LSD blotters and 200 ecstasy pills. All the material was seized by the Guardia di Finanza.
Part of the cocaine had a particular composition. The substance had been mixed with methamphetamines and artificially flavored, according to what was reported during the operation, with strawberry, grape, coconut and melon flavors. The stated objective was so-called criminal marketing, with a characterization of the product intended for drug dealing.
During the searches, 6.600 euros in cash were also recovered, a sum identified as proceeds from drug dealing. Investigators also found two precision scales. The seizure also included a taser, a machete, a baseball bat, a telescopic baton and a folding knife.
The search of the camper and of the home of the Italian man who was to receive the drugs made it possible to complete the recovery of the material. The Comando Provinciale della Guardia di Finanza di Varese thus seized both the substances and the objects found during the checks, simultaneously arresting the three people present.
According to the reconstruction provided by the Fiamme Gialle, selling the entire load would have yielded more than five million euros. The figure concerns the value that the sale of the seized material could have generated, consisting of cocaine, marijuana, hashish, heroin, LSD and ecstasy.
The operation is part of the economic control of the territory carried out by the Comando Provinciale, including in areas near the wooded areas of the province. The stated aim is to prevent and combat the possession of narcotic substances intended for drug dealing. The operation therefore concerned both the transfer of the bag and the contents kept in the camper and in the home that was searched. ### Referral to the Judicial Authority After the arrest, the three individuals were taken to the prisons in Varese and Como. They were placed at the disposal of the Judicial Authority of Varese, which has jurisdiction over the proceedings connected to the Guardia di Finanza operation.
The Judicial Authority of Varese validated the searches, the seizure and the arrest. The arrested individuals must answer charges of drug trafficking and possession of improvised weapons. The source does not indicate any further judicial developments beyond the measures already validated.
A separate follow-up concerned Watson, the small dachshund present in the camper. The dog proved extremely patient and docile throughout all stages of the operation. After the vehicle was stopped, he was initially cared for at the barracks by Guardia di Finanza officers.
Subsequently, Watson was entrusted to a family that voluntarily offered to provide temporary adoption. The accommodation was therefore found after the assistance he received at the barracks, while the three arrested individuals were being transferred to the prisons in Varese and Como.
The operation is also presented by the Fiamme Gialle as a testament to the Guardia di Finanza's strong social vocation. Alongside its typical economic and financial police function, the Corps works to protect the entire community, intervening against phenomena considered to pose a particular social alarm and a danger to public safety and health.
These phenomena include the trafficking and dealing of narcotic substances, which were at the center of the intervention in the wooded areas of the province of Varese. The seizure of the consignment, the validation of the measures and Watson's temporary placement represent the developments indicated by the source after the camper and the Fiat 500 were stopped.
*Source: [varesenoi.it](https://www.varesenoi.it/2026/10/03/leggi-notizia/argomenti/cronaca-20/articolo/oltre-70-chili-di-stupefacenti-sul-camper-della-droga-la-finanza-di-varese-arresta-tre-persone.html)*

item.title: Carluccio Nursery School Como: staff writes to the Municipality
item.description: The staff of the Carluccio preschool on Via Volta writes to the Mayor to oppose the cuts: the school is not a cost, but a community investment.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - After September 28, the staff wrote a new letter. - Carluccio is the preschool on via Volta in Como. - The positive ruling: Carluccio remains open. - Signed by Bozzi, ten teachers and the school assistant.
## Key facts - Location → Carluccio preschool, via Volta, Como - Document → letter from Maria Grazia Bozzi - Signatories → ten teachers and the school assistant - Debate → reorganization involving closures and mergers - Precedent → closure decided by the Municipal Administration two years ago - Appeal → TAR, filed to defend the school - Outcome → positive ruling: Carluccio remains open - Symbol → olive tree given by Comitato Nova Como in September
After the City Council meeting of September 28, Carluccio preschool is once again at the center of the debate over the reorganization of schools in Como. The reorganization sought by the Rapinese administration provides for closures and mergers; the majority approved a resolution on the downsizing of schools. It is from this development that the new letter from the staff of the preschool on via Volta stems.
The letter is signed by Maria Grazia Bozzi, the school’s representative. The document also bears the signatures of ten teachers and the school assistant. The letter is addressed to the Mayor and the Councillor for Education and Educational Policies and argues that one cannot remain indifferent in the face of the resolution. The text makes clear that it does not intend to repeat the explanations already set out in previous letters concerning the effects of mergers and closures; instead, it chooses to return to the reality of Carluccio.
The text recalls what happened two years ago. The Municipal Administration had decided on the closure of the school. Families, committees, teachers and the entire school community did not remain indifferent to that decision. Thanks to the determination of the families, the committees and, in particular, Comitato Nova Como, together with the teachers and Istituto Comprensivo Como Borgovico, a campaign was launched to defend Carluccio. The process also led to an appeal to the TAR. Then came the positive ruling: the school remained open.
Teachers, parents and the entire Istituto Comprensivo Como Borgovico celebrated that decision, because Carluccio is not simply a place in which to welcome children. For the staff, it is a school founded on educational values, on a specific view of the child and on a pedagogical project built day after day. The letter thus calls into question an understanding of the school based solely on organizational or numerical criteria, as if it were merely the place where children are left while their parents work. The position expressed is unequivocal: Carluccio must be considered for what it represents educationally and within the community, not merely for its place in the reorganization of schools. ### An Educational Project Built Every Day
La Carluccio is described as a socio-educational hub in the heart of the city of Como. In the document, attention shifts from the organizational aspect to the meaning of preschool. It is the first educational environment in which children experience relationships with others, learn to share and communicate, recognize their own emotions and those of others, and gradually become independent. For the letter, these steps describe the school’s daily work.
The structure of the project moves from sections to spaces, from workshops to the schedule of the day and the stable presence of teachers. The document considers them integral parts of the educational project, not secondary components to be improvised. The environments must be designed to allow children to explore, experiment, play, create, and learn. The stable presence of teachers also has an educational and relational function: the reference figures know each child’s development, characteristics, vulnerabilities, and potential.
The word continuity occupies a central place in the letter. Continuity means not viewing each school year as an isolated experience, but building a path that accompanies the child as they grow. The educational thread must connect teachers, families, and the local community and, subsequently, preschool and primary school. Time and conditions are also needed to observe each child in their uniqueness: not everyone learns in the same way, not everyone has the same pace, and not everyone expresses their needs through words.
La Carluccio is also described as a place of inclusion. Differences can become a source of enrichment, and every child must be able to find their own space, feel part of the group, and develop their potential. This reading leads to criticism of an assessment based solely on the number of enrolled children, the spaces occupied, or a financial statement. A school is made up of relationships, skills, experiences, professionalism, and community. La Carluccio, the staff writes, represents all of this.
Another element mentioned in the letter is the olive tree donated to the school by Comitato Nova Como last school year, in September. The tree was chosen as a symbol of rebirth, strength, and resilience. For teachers and school staff, it aptly represents the school: once again, they have started anew with determination and passion, continuing to believe in the value of their work and in the strength of the educational project. ### The request to listen to the community
The letter indicates the criterion to follow before making decisions about Carluccio's future. The staff asks that those who experience the school every day be listened to: the children, families, teachers and all the school staff. The document specifies that the value of the school concerns not only the families who attend it today, but the entire community. For this reason, the assessment of its future should not stop at the premises, the numbers or the economic dimension mentioned in the text.
The point called for by the authors therefore concerns recognizing the network built over time. According to the letter, closing or scaling back a preschool would mean breaking up a network of relationships and weakening an educational hub. That network includes the relationship between children, families, teachers and the local area, along with the path connecting preschool to primary school. Carluccio is thus presented as an institution that belongs to the community, not merely to the families who attend it today.
The document then returns to the image of roots. Carluccio school has already shown that it has deep roots, and the olive tree donated by Comitato Nova Como has become their symbol. Those roots, the staff writes, ask to be respected, nurtured and allowed to grow. Behind a school there are not only walls and numbers: there are children, people, relationships, an educational project and a community. The letter links to this heritage the idea that a community capable of investing in its children also invests in its future.
The signatures make the position expressed in the document a collective one. In addition to the representative Maria Grazia Bozzi, the teachers Angelica Sansone, Giorgia Marchio, Paola Della Bosca, Sabrina Ghielmetti, Domenica Previtali, Virginia Fiandaca, Manuela Ghislanzoni, Lucia D'Angelo, Francesca Pellegrino and Silvana Somaini sign. The school support staff member identified is Nunzia Battista.
> «The school is not a cost to be reduced: it is an investment to be protected.»
This is the phrase with which the staff summarizes the request for protection addressed to those who will have to deal with the future of the Carluccio preschool.
*Source: [comozero.it](https://comozero.it/attualita/como-lettera-da-tutto-il-personale-dellasilo-carluccio-la-scuola-non-e-un-costo-da-ridurre-qui-ce-una-comunita/)*

item.title: Varese-pergine mastiffs: challenge to the acinque ice arena
item.description: Saturday at 18.30 the Mastiffs host the Pergine. Varese, Pergine and Feltre look for points in the ranking at level 3 on the fourth day of IHL.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Varese host Pergine on Saturday at 18.30 - Mastini and Linci are on 3 points - Vanetti and Terzago remain out - Franchini may be called up
## Key facts - Game → Varese-Pergine - Venue → Acinque Ice Arena - Standings → Varese, Pergine and Feltre are on 3 points - Absences → Vanetti and Terzago - Shots on goal → Varese 35, Caldaro 33 - Power play → figure reversed compared with last year
At 18.30 on Saturday, Varese's Mastini host Pergine at the Acinque Ice Arena. It is a direct clash between two mid-table teams: Varese, Pergine and Feltre are level on 3 points, six points behind the Caldaro-Aosta duo. The game is part of the fourth matchday of the IHL and comes after the Mastini's away game at Caldaro.
The game in South Tyrol left one certainty and one obligation. The certainty concerns the character of the team coached by Dave Rich. Trailing 3-0 after less than nine minutes, the black-and-yellow side got back into the game in the second period. Then Selva's goal, scored 11 seconds before the second buzzer, shifted the momentum toward the Lucci, who managed to confirm their superiority in the third period.
The obligation is to turn that reaction into points against a Pergine side described as a strong team. The Linci will also bring their supporters to the Acinque Ice Arena, while Varese will have to reproduce the quick attacks and offensive play shown in the last outing.
### A team with more options
Against Caldaro, the Mastini finished with 35 shots on goal, compared with 33 attempts by their opponents. The numbers reflect an attack with several options: Bastille, De Toni, Borghi, Piroso and the new arrival Glasman are listed among the most dangerous players up front.
The defense also offered positive signs, although it needs reinforcements to preserve energy and focus. Filippo Matonti was once again among the best. Among the goaltenders, Leonardo Mordenti's return home is also noted. Another positive element is the power play, described as completely transformed compared with last year.
### The roster and the home-ice factor
Dave Rich will decide whether to dress Franchini based on the forward's physical condition. Captain Vanetti will remain out for around twenty days because of a muscle problem, while Terzago is still unavailable. The absence of both forces the defense to operate with a five-man rotation.
The performances against Fassa and Caldaro are presented as an incentive to fill the arena. According to the game preview, the black-and-yellow faithful will have to be the extra man on the ice. The comparison between Varese and Pergine’s campaigns explains why the game has the profile of a direct clash, without turning the standings into a prediction. After three matchdays, both teams have 3 points, along with Feltre, while Caldaro and Aosta lead with 9.
| Team | Campaign in the opening matchdays | |---|---| | Varese | Home defeat to Appiano 2-4; win at Fassa 5-3; away game at Caldaro | | Pergine | Home defeat to Fassa 3-6; comeback against Val Pusteria Junior 4-3; home defeat to Appiano 1-5 |
The most useful reference point is Fassa. Varese won on its ice, while Pergine lost at home against the same team. It is the comparison that warrants a fair degree of optimism, but the same source reminds us that every game is a story unto itself. The outcome of the direct clash will therefore depend on the ability to reproduce the positive indications on the ice, not merely on the sequence of previous games.
### The Linci profile
Pergine should not be underestimated either because of last season’s campaign. The Linci of Valsugana finished fifth and, in the playoff quarterfinals, immediately overturned home-ice advantage against Appiano. This is a precedent that supports a cautious reading of the game.
James Thomas Dowd is the name identified as the main offensive reference point. He has already scored against Fassa and Appiano and has been well supported by Foccoli, Bitetto and Dellmar Speranza. Andreotti, meanwhile, is described as a player capable of striking in crucial moments. Defensively, some uncertainty remains in the Linci’s setup: this is the weak point the Mastini will have to try to exploit.
### The key to the clash
The game therefore pits Varese’s offensive variety against an opponent that has shown quality, but also possible vulnerability at the back. The Pergine crowd will be passionate, while the yellow-and-black crowd is called upon to support the team at the Acinque Ice Arena. For those who also consult the portal for annunci lavoro, this page remains dedicated to sports coverage: the data to follow here are results, standings, setups and performance on the ice.
## Recommended tools For an updated estimate, use the net salary calculator and the CHF-EUR exchange comparator. To follow Varese vs Pergine in an organized way, the first reference is the schedule for the fourth day of IHL. The Mastini's appointment is set for Saturday at 6:30 PM at the Acinque Ice Arena. In the same round, Appiano vs Pusteria Junior is scheduled at 7:00 PM, followed by Caldaro vs Fassa, Feltre vs Valpellice at 7:30 PM, and Aosta vs Alleghe at 8:00 PM. Fiemme, meanwhile, observes a rest day.
### Five steps to follow
1. Check Varese's lineup. The decision regarding Franchini will depend on the forward's physical condition. Vanetti and Terzago remain out, forcing the defense to rotate with five men.
2. Watch the start. In Caldaro, the Mastini were down 3-0 after less than nine minutes, but they reacted in the second period. Managing the start will therefore be one of the first elements to observe.
3. Measure offensive production. Against Caldaro, Varese shot 35 times, while their opponents finished 33 times. Fast transitions and the ability to involve Bastille, De Toni, Borghi, Piroso, and Glasman represent the benchmarks indicated on the eve of the match.
4. Follow power plays and defensive coverage. The power play game is described as much improved compared to last year; at the back, however, the group needs more oxygen and clarity.
5. Read the result alongside the other matches. Varese and Pergine both start with 3 points, so the final score will need to be placed within the context of the standings after the fourth round.
The follow-up to the match can also be found on the 'Porta tre dischi' podcast. The second episode of the broadcast that aired on Tuesday the 29th on Radio Materia is available, featuring Marcello Borghi as a guest in the studio. The yellow-and-black striker chose the three songs that punctuated his interview.

item.title: AVS Fund in Ticino: the 13th payment for young people
item.description: A Fund was presented in Ticino: those who will be able and willing to waive the 13th AVS payment will support projects dedicated to the younger generations for the benefit of the community.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Fund presented today in Ticino - Financing through waiving the 13th AVS payment - Resources allocated to projects for new generations
## Key facts - What → Fund for the benefit of the community - Financing → waiving the 13th AVS payment - Who can waive it → those who will be able and willing to do so - Allocation → projects for new generations in Ticino
### The presentation Presented today in Ticino, the Fund is being established with a formula that shifts a possible individual waiver toward a collective objective. The financing, according to the announcement, will be provided by those who will be able and willing to waive the 13th AVS payment in order to donate it to projects aimed at new generations in Ticino.
The central point is therefore the choice of the individual pensioner. The source does not describe the waiver as an obligation and does not present the Fund as a generalized levy: it speaks of people who will be able and willing to allocate their 13th AVS payment to the new initiative. Financial resources and personal willingness are the only conditions mentioned in the text.
The allocation is defined broadly but precisely: projects dedicated to young people and, through them, a benefit for the community. However, the projects, areas of intervention, amount of the 13th AVS payment to be donated, or the time when the Fund will begin collecting the waivers are not listed.
The announcement also does not indicate who will select the initiatives, what procedure those wishing to participate will have to follow, or whether specific communications for donors will be planned. For this reason, the news records the establishment and funding principle of the Fund, but does not yet offer operational guidance.
The generational pact formula links two groups named in the title, pensioners and young people, but does not alter this scope: the source does not attribute statements to individuals or institutions and does not report figures, deadlines, or regulatory references. Thus, only two elements remain central: waiving the 13th AVS payment and donating it to initiatives for new generations.
For those following the AVS issue, the point to retain is the voluntary transformation of the 13th payment into a donation intended for new generations. The territorial reference is Ticino; the source does not extend the scope to occupational categories or cross-border workers. A approfondimento sull'AVS can help keep the content of the announcement separate from the information not indicated here. ## The scope for the cross-border reader
### What can be said, and what cannot For a cross-border worker, the practical reading must start with a limitation: the announcement concerns a possible destination for the 13th AVS payment, but does not present a measure specifically dedicated to cross-border work. The only explicit connection with social security is the reference to AVS. The text does not say whether the Fund is aimed at workers, pensioners residing in a specific place, or people belonging to an administrative category.
Consequently, no information can be derived regarding the G permit, LPP, LAMal, refunds, withholding tax, or INPS. Nor do Brogeda, the new 2026 tax agreement, or double taxation appear. These references are not part of the announcement and cannot be used to supplement it.
The reference to the Canton of Ticino must also be read within its scope: it indicates where the projects for the younger generations are directed. It does not identify the donors’ place of residence, their employer, or their tax status. The text does not connect the Fund to permits, payslips, transfers, border crossings, or relations with Italian authorities.
| Element stated | Information not provided | | --- | --- | | Waiver of the 13th AVS payment | Amount and arrangements | | Who will be able and willing to join | Requirements and documents | | Projects for young people in Ticino | List and criteria | | Pact in favor of the community | Management and deadlines |
The table highlights the difference between an announced principle and an applicable measure. For the cross-border worker, this distinction prevents the news from being read as a change to cross-border taxation or social security. The source does not say that the withholding tax, G permit, or AVS status of those who work across the border will change; it simply does not address these aspects.
Anyone wishing to keep the focus solely on the social security chapter can consult strumento AVS e LPP, using it as general background and not as proof of the Fund’s requirements.
## Useful planning tools To estimate your pension strategy, use the pension planner and the pillar 3 simulator. ## How to read the announcement before taking action
### A three-step check The source does not provide a procedure for joining the Fund. Therefore, the most appropriate action, given the information available, is to separate the confirmed facts from the questions that remain open, without turning an announcement into an operational circular.
1. **Start with the certain fact.** The 13th AVS payment may be allocated to the Fund by those who will be able and willing to waive it. The stated purpose is projects dedicated to the younger generations in Ticino.
2. List the gaps. The amount, timing of the waiver, method of joining, any documents, criteria for selecting projects, and management of donations still need to be clarified. The source provides none of these elements.
3. Keep your personal situation separate. For cross-border workers, the announcement does not make it possible to infer any effects on permits, work, taxation, or commuting. No connection is indicated with administrative procedures other than the possible donation of the 13th AVS payment.
This check avoids confusing the Fund's principle with an instruction to apply immediately. The text does not mention a form, an office, a deadline, or a confirmation channel for anyone intending to waive the 13th AVS payment. Without this data, it is not possible to devise a more detailed procedure while remaining faithful to the source.
The wording chosen for the initiative nevertheless remains clear about its voluntary nature: it does not describe an automatic waiver, but rather the decision of those who will be able and willing to allocate their 13th payment to projects for young people. Any personal assessment must therefore remain distinct from the information not contained in the announcement.
If a communication about the Fund subsequently indicates the missing steps, it will be possible to compare it with these basic elements without adding interpretations. To explore the pension-related aspect only using a tool on the site, use the calcolatore AVS e LPP.

item.title: Hockey, Ambrì conquer the BCF Arena: Fribourg beaten 2-1
item.description: After two defeats, Ambrì rediscover their solidity and win 2-1 in Fribourg. Goals by Müller and Schnarr prove decisive in an evening of great defensive sacrifice.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Ambrì wins 2-1 on Friborgo's ice - Müller and Schnarr score the decisive goals - Pestoni returns in place of the suspended Borradori - At 12', Miles Müller puts the blue-and-whites ahead
## Key facts - Result → 2-1 for Ambrì - Arena → BCF Arena - Return → Inti Pestoni - Absence → Tim Heed - Defense → six regular defensemen - Penalty kill → 66,6% before the game - Goaltending choice → Galley preferred to Waeber
After two consecutive home defeats, Ambrì were looking for crucial points in the den of the Swiss champions. At BCF Arena, the response came with a 2-1 victory, built on solidity, sacrifice and efficiency—in other words, the elements Tapola wanted to rediscover. Some cork stoppers with nails inserted and the points facing upward were reportedly found in the parking lot behind Tigros in Luino. Paolo Nicastri, a young man from Luino and former candidate for mayor of Luino in the May 2026 municipal elections, made the discovery public through social media.
The site is frequented by cars and motorcyclists and is also used by driving schools for practice sessions and exams for a motorcycle license. The presence of the corks therefore concerns an area where different users move around and where practical training activities also take place.
In the published video, Nicastri shows some corks into which nails appear to have been inserted. The points are oriented upward. The young man from Luino highlights the risk that a motorcyclist might ride over them, puncture a tire and fall. His question in the video draws attention to the possible immediate consequences of those objects being present on the ground.
The focus of the report is the physical danger posed by the nails and the particular use of the parking lot. Nicastri links the discovery to the safety of those who use the area, with specific attention to students taking part in practice sessions and exams for a motorcycle license.
The report published on social media therefore starts from this concrete element: the presence of sharp objects, with the points facing upward, in a Luino parking lot frequented by cars, motorcycles and driving schools. ## A parking lot also used for motorcycle tests
The role of driving schools is the point Nicastri emphasizes most in the video. He does not merely recall that the parking lot is frequented by motorcyclists: he stresses that practice sessions and motorcycle license tests take place in the same space. The presence of the nails is therefore described in relation to those who might cross the area during a training or examination activity.
> It is precisely in this parking lot that driving schools conduct practice sessions and motorcycle license exams
In his reasoning, the risk concerns not only the possible fall of a young person on a motorcycle. Nicastri also raises the possibility that a driving-school vehicle could puncture one or more tires by driving over the nails. In that case, he observes, the danger to people would be accompanied by financial damage. The report is thus linked both to physical safety and to the material consequences for those who use the parking lot.
The video also refers to some complaints that, according to Nicastri, have concerned the area recently. The reference is not turned into an accusation against anyone. Instead, the young man from Luino asks that any disputes over the use of the area be handled without adopting behavior capable of endangering other people.
The message also addresses the issue of motorcycle enthusiasts. Nicastri wonders whether it is possible to identify a dedicated and safe space for them, alongside the discussion of the risks present in a parking lot used for traffic and driving-school activities.
The reaction described by the source therefore remains a position conveyed through social media: safety for those taking the tests, attention to possible tire damage, and a request not to let complaints about the area degenerate into dangerous acts. ## The clarification about who left the caps
Paolo Nicastri accompanies the report with a clear clarification regarding responsibility for the act. He says he does not know who left the objects in the parking lot and makes it clear that he does not want to accuse anyone without concrete evidence. In the video, he states that he has no proof. His report, therefore, does not identify anyone responsible and keeps the discovery of the caps separate from any possible attribution of the act.
This passage also defines the scope of the matter described by the source. The issue reported at present is the presence of cork stoppers with nails pointing upward and the danger they may pose to cars, motorcycles and driving schools. Nicastri does not identify who allegedly left them, focusing his report on the objects found and their position in the parking lot.
The video’s conclusion returns specifically to safety. For the former mayoral candidate, the combination of nails pointing upward and a parking lot frequented by vehicles and motorcyclists constitutes an enormous danger. In his words, the same assessment applies to an area where driving schools take students for practice sessions and motorcycle license exams.
The continuation documented by the source contains neither an indication of who did it nor any further reconstruction of the act. The report therefore remains focused on the alarm raised through social media and on the need, emphasized by Nicastri, not to put the health or lives of those passing through the parking lot at risk.
The position expressed is twofold: on the one hand, it reports the cork stoppers with their points facing upward as a concrete fact; on the other, it avoids turning the report into an accusation without evidence. The central fact remains the one stated in the video: those objects, in that location, can create a very serious risk for anyone using the parking lot.

item.title: Serious accident on the A2 in Coldrerio
item.description: Southbound rear-end collision: a 68-year-old woman was slightly injured, while the 73-year-old passenger is in serious condition.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Accident on Friday shortly before 15.30 on the A2 in Coldrerio - A car rear-ended a stationary articulated lorry in the emergency bay - The 73-year-old passenger was taken to hospital by helicopter - The A2 was closed and then reduced to one lane
## Key facts - Location → A2, southbound, Coldrerio area - Time → Friday, shortly before 15.30 - Driver → 68-year-old Swiss woman, resident in the Canton of Zurich - Passenger → 73-year-old Swiss man, resident in the Canton of Zurich - Conditions → woman slightly injured; man in serious condition - Traffic → temporary closure, then traffic on one lane - Responders → SAM, REGA, firefighters and cantonal police
### The initial account of the accident
On Friday afternoon, shortly before 15.30, a serious accident occurred on the A2 motorway in the southbound direction, in the Coldrerio area. The cantonal police reported that a 68-year-old Swiss woman, resident in the Canton of Zurich, rear-ended an articulated lorry stopped beside the carriageway, in the emergency bay. The causes of the collision will have to be established by the investigation.
Also travelling in the car was a 73-year-old Swiss passenger, likewise resident in the Canton of Zurich. After initial treatment, both were taken to hospital. The woman was taken by ambulance with minor injuries. The man, however, was transported by helicopter in serious condition; his life is in danger.
To allow rescue operations and the landing of the REGA helicopter, the carriageway was temporarily closed. Subsequently, traffic was funnelled into a single lane. The measure had a very significant impact on traffic.
The involvement of two people required two separate transports, by ambulance for the driver and by helicopter for the passenger. The difference in the modes of transport corresponds to the conditions reported by the police: minor injuries for the woman, serious condition for the man.
The rescue operation involved SAM rescuers, a REGA helicopter, firefighters from the Mendrisiotto rescue centre and the cantonal police. The investigation will have to establish the causes of the rear-end collision. ## Traffic difficulties in the Mendrisiotto
The temporary closure of the motorway and the subsequent reduction to a single lane had very significant consequences for traffic. At 5 p.m., the police advised against setting off southbound. The warning was issued while rescue operations had already affected mobility in the area.
### The roads affected
According to Viasuisse, in the late afternoon traffic was completely congested on all roads between Mendrisio and Genestrerio. The situation did not affect only the motorway route: the report also included the cantonal road between Mendrisio and Chiasso, the San Martino fork toward Melide and, in Lugano, the main roads in the city center.
| Area | Reported situation | |---|---| | Roads between Mendrisio and Genestrerio | Traffic completely congested | | Cantonal road between Mendrisio and Chiasso | Traffic completely congested | | San Martino fork toward Melide | Traffic completely congested | | Main roads in central Lugano | Traffic completely congested |
Viasuisse’s reports therefore covered a series of different connections: the stretch between the two centers of the Mendrisiotto, the cantonal road toward Chiasso, the road at the San Martino fork in the direction of Melide and the central streets of Lugano. All these points were completely congested in the late afternoon.
The picture provided by Viasuisse shows that the repercussions were not concentrated solely at the site of the accident. The closure and the switch to one lane affected traffic in several areas, while the police advice at 5 p.m. urged people to avoid traveling south.
The situation then improved after 8 p.m. This is the latest time-based update reported by the source on traffic conditions, following the congestion reported in the late afternoon. ## The investigation remains open
### The aftermath of the operation
The aftermath of the accident remains linked to the investigation into how it happened. The cantonal police indicated that it will have to establish the reasons why the motorist rear-ended the articulated lorry stopped in the emergency lay-by. The essential details of the reconstruction thus remain established: the collision occurred on the A2, heading south, in the territory of Coldrerio, with a heavy vehicle stopped at the side of the carriageway. The investigation will have to clarify the sequence of events that led to the collision.
The operational follow-up is already defined by the sequence of the rescue efforts. After receiving initial treatment, the two people were taken to hospital: the woman by ambulance and the man by helicopter. To allow the rescue operation and the landing of the REGA helicopter, the carriageway was temporarily closed; later, traffic was channelled into a single lane. SAM rescuers, the REGA helicopter, firefighters from the Mendrisiotto rescue centre and the cantonal police attended the scene.
The medical situation reported for the passenger also remains: the 73-year-old man was transported by helicopter in serious condition and his life is in danger. The 68-year-old woman, on the other hand, was taken to hospital by ambulance with minor injuries. The police statement therefore distinguishes between two different outcomes and leaves the follow-up of the investigation into how the accident happened open.

item.description: A 22-year-old man was reported while at liberty for aggravated robbery and sexual assault following an attack near the station in Gallarate; the victim, a 36-year-old woman, was discharged with a prognosis of seven days.

## In brief - A 22-year-old reported for aggravated robbery and sexual assault - Assault in the area of Gallarate station - The woman discharged with a prognosis of seven days - The young man identified by the woman at the barracks

### The intervention in Gallarate In the early hours of Thursday 21 September, in the area of Gallarate railway station, the Carabinieri intervened after an emergency call came in to 112. The incident led to a 22-year-old being reported while at liberty, accused of aggravated robbery and sexual assault.
The first intervention was carried out by officers from the Operational and Radiomobile Unit at around one in the morning, in via Curioni. On site, they found a woman alone, described as being in an evident state of shock, and provided her with first aid. The call therefore drew the officers' attention to the area near the railway station, where the woman had asked for help.
The woman told the officers that she had been approached shortly beforehand by a young man and that her mobile phone had been forcibly taken. The account concerns an evening spent with some friends and a subsequent assault in the station area. According to the officers' reconstruction, the phone theft was accompanied by sexual violence and physical consequences.
After the request for help, the officers began investigations at the scene. The text thus links the call to 112, the assistance provided in via Curioni and the investigation launched by the Gallarate Station. The events were reconstructed based on the woman's account and the officers' immediate checks.
The charges communicated concern two allegations: aggravated robbery and sexual assault. The young man, identified in the source as 22 years old, was reported while at liberty. The report places the Carabinieri intervention in the station area and links the reconstruction to the call to 112, the assistance provided in via Curioni and the checks carried out by the Gallarate Station.
The account therefore includes Piazza Giovanni XXIII, where the woman was spending the evening, the area near the railway station and via Curioni, where the officers provided first aid. These are the places indicated in the source to describe the beginning of the incident and the intervention by the Carabinieri. ## The reconstruction of the night
The sequence recounted to the officers begins at Piazza Giovanni XXIII, where the woman was spending the evening with some friends. After her cellphone was taken, she followed the young man in an attempt to get the smartphone back. The young man was riding an electric scooter, and the route led to the vicinity of the railway station, on Via Curioni.
According to the officers' reconstruction, the young man took advantage of the absence of passersby to attack the woman. He restrained her, tore her T-shirt, and forced her to submit to groping and sexual acts. The same reconstruction reports that the assault caused her physical injuries and abrasions.
During the frantic moments of the assault, the woman noticed a medium-sized kitchen knife. The man had it hidden in the waistband of his trousers. The detail of the knife appears in the officers' reconstruction together with the description of the absence of passersby.
The passing of a pedestrian interrupted the violence. The young man fled, and the woman was able to raise the alarm and request help. The officers found her in a state of shock when they arrived on Via Curioni.
### The hospital visit After receiving initial assistance, the woman was transported under a green code to the emergency department of the Sant'Antonio Abate Hospital in Gallarate. The transfer was for the necessary clinical examinations and dressings. Medical staff found various superficial wounds and then discharged her with a seven-day prognosis for recovery.
The visit to the emergency department represents the subsequent medical stage after the initial assistance provided on Via Curioni. The source indicates the green code, the clinical examinations, the dressings, the superficial wounds, and the discharge with a seven-day prognosis. The discharge came after the examinations and dressings, with the seven-day period indicated for recovery. ## Developments in the investigation
The inquiries by the Gallarate Carabinieri Station began immediately, after the woman filed her complaint on 21 September. The source indicates that the officers worked from the earliest stages of the case to determine the identity of the alleged perpetrator. According to the text, the result came within a few hours.
The young man was traced to his home and taken to the station. The source describes him as a 22-year-old of Peruvian origin. At the station, the victim recognized him without a shadow of a doubt. This step is reported before the young man was referred to the Judicial Authority.
### From the complaint to the referral The term used in the report for the outcome of the inquiries is referral to the Judicial Authority. The young man was therefore reported without being detained on charges of aggravated robbery and sexual assault. The source also reports that the investigation is continuing in close coordination with the authority to establish every detail of the case.
The investigative chronology indicated is brief but precise: complaint on 21 September, immediate inquiries, identification within a few hours, being traced at his home, being taken to the station, and recognition by the woman. After these steps, the 22-year-old was referred to the Judicial Authority.
The source also points out a discrepancy in the indication of the woman's age: the opening says 35, while the section on the reconstruction and the headline identify her as 36. The information is reported this way in the source; the investigative developments, however, remain those attributed to the Carabinieri of the Gallarate Station: identification of the young man, recognition at the station, and continuation of the investigation to clarify the case.

On Sunday, October 4, the Gavirate lakeside will be the focal point of the weekend in the Varese area. The Pumpkin Festival, listed in the roundup as the main event, brings together food stalls, entertainment and live music.
### Pumpkin Festival and road traffic
The program also includes a historical re-enactment, with a camp and faithfully recreated artifacts relating to Celts, Lombards and Normans, as well as a chestnut festival. The lakeside event is therefore the main autumn event among those listed for the weekend.
That same Sunday, the Grand Fondo Tre Valli Varesine, an amateur cycling race that will pass along numerous roads in the province of Varese, is on the calendar. The source notes possible travel difficulties precisely because many roads will be closed due to the event passing through.
The roundup also points to a detailed article with the scheduled times and closures, intended to help plan travel. The issue of road traffic therefore accompanies the presentation of Sunday's events, alongside the food and cultural program of the Pumpkin Festival.
The first weekend of October is presented as a transition between the newly begun autumn and outdoor activities. The weather is described as mild and pleasant, while the calendar brings together food stalls, cultural events and recreational opportunities for the whole family.
The roundup does not concentrate its offerings in a single location: alongside the lakeside events are musical initiatives, tastings, sports activities and evenings devoted to culture. The province of Varese is thus preparing for a packed weekend, with the cycling race and the related road closures as factors to consider when traveling on Sunday. ## The appointment map
The weekend program combines the Pumpkin Festival with a series of initiatives distributed across Varese and other places in the province. The proposal ranges from cuisine to music, from wines to local history, without giving up events designed for free time.
### Between tastings, music and words
At Schiranna, in the party area, the Oktoberfest in the city continues until October 18th, with flavors and fun in Munich style. Every weekend there will be food stands, music and entertainment.
On Saturday 3 October the Cloister of Voltorre hosts Chiostro diVino, an evening dedicated to tasting wines from twelve wineries. The tasting is scheduled to start from 5pm, while the Bollicine masterclass is scheduled for 4pm.
Choral music finds space on Saturday at 9pm in the Brunella Church with Tra cielo e terra. The event involves the Sine Nomine Choir, directed by Giuseppe Reggiori, and the organist Andrea Gottardello.
Also on Saturday, at 9pm in the Council Room, the book Il dialetto del lago di Varese will be presented. It is a dialect-Italian and Italian-dialect vocabulary created by Maurizio Danelli and Giorgio Sassi.
At 7pm, at Origini Local Bakery in via Lombardia 52/A, Origini Country Fest is scheduled. The evening offers a Wild West atmosphere, music and local flavours.
The summary of events also highlights a food stand in Caldana, in the Cocquio area, AgriMornago and Zuccagnata in Cadrezzate with Osmate. In Marchirolo Sardinian cuisine is the protagonist, while in Malnate mushrooms are offered and in Capronno di Angera polenta. They are different proposals, but united by the presence of food, music or entertainment within the provincial program. ## Timetables and travel
The sports program indicated by the event is spread over two days and features different times for the trials, the race and the related initiatives. The schedule reported for the Tre Valli Varesine is as follows.
### Race schedule
| Day | Time | Event | |---|---:|---| | Saturday 3 | 11.20-11.50 | Gran Fondo Time Trial practice | | Saturday 3 | 12-17.30 | Actual race | | Sunday 4 | 9-17 | Gran Fondo |
Sunday's race affects numerous roads in the province of Varese. For this reason, the source points out the possibility of complicated travel and refers readers to the information dedicated to road closures. The same reference also indicates changes relating to the Autolinee Varesine service.
The Sunday program also includes StraWoman, a non-competitive run-walk event dedicated to women. The StraWoman Village is set up at the Giardini Estensi: it is scheduled to open at 8 for the distribution of race packets, while the start is set for 10:30. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 12.
Alongside the run, entertainment areas and activities dedicated to health are planned. The sporting day therefore takes place between the Village at the Giardini Estensi and the Grand Fondo route, with separate events and schedules.
Sunday's overall picture thus remains linked to two elements documented in the event: on the one hand, the presence of sporting events with times already indicated, and on the other, the closure of many roads linked to the passage of the cycling race. For public transport services, the source refers readers to the Autolinee Varesine changes available in the dedicated in-depth article.

item.description: The coxswain of Dumenza wins bronze at the FISU World University Championships in Canada and silver at the Under-23 European Championships in Poland.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Two international podium finishes for Martina Bonalumi - Bronze at the FISU World University Championships in Ontario - Silver at the Under-23 European Championships in Kruszwica - Mayor Moro celebrates the team and its educational value
## Key facts - Protagonist → Martina Bonalumi - Role → coxswain of the Italian women's eight - First result → bronze in Ontario, Canada - Second result → silver in Kruszwica, Poland - Final → second place behind Romania - Community → Dumenza - Mayor → Corrado Nazario Moro - Federation → Italian Rowing Federation
Two international podium finishes within just a few weeks have placed Martina Bonalumi's name at the center of Dumenza's pride. The young coxswain of the Italian women's eight first won the bronze medal at the FISU World University Championships held in Ontario, Canada, and then a prestigious silver medal at the Under-23 European Championships in Kruszwica, Poland.
The journey recounted by the Dumenza community therefore unfolds across two closely spaced events and two notable placings. After her podium performance in Canada, Bonalumi guided the Italian boat in the European category final. On board with her were Alessandra Grasselli, Sara Lisi, Vittoria Piller, Isabella Mihalescu, Neve Aroldi, Lucrezia Monaci, Matilde Orsetti and Giorgia Sciattella.
The Italian crew put in a highly solid and consistent performance. The final ended with Italy in second place, behind Romania and ahead of all the other crews competing. The Italian Rowing Federation highlighted the extraordinary cohesion demonstrated by the Italian eight during the international competition.
On behalf of the municipal administration and the citizens, Mayor Corrado Nazario Moro sent Bonalumi a congratulatory message. The mayor linked the two podium finishes not only to the sporting result, but also to the human value of the performance and the young coxswain's ability to take on the responsibilities of the role.
> “Behind these results,” commented the mayor of Dumenza, Corrado Nazario Moro, “are talent, sacrifice, consistency and an extraordinary ability to work as a team.”
In the mayor's message, Martina Bonalumi's result thus also becomes a source of shared pride. The medal won in Poland, together with the bronze earned in Ontario, is presented as the fruit of collective work in which the coxswain had the task of guiding the Italian eight. The double sequence fills the entire Dumenza community with pride and makes the young fellow citizen's international journey visible. ## The meaning of a collective result
The double podium finish is presented by the mayor of Dumenza as a meeting point between individual performance and collective work. Martina Bonalumi is the face of the news, but the European result belongs to a crew: her role acquires meaning together with the eight athletes of the Italian boat. Federazione Italiana Canottaggio in fact highlighted the cohesion of the eight, not an isolated result.
### The coxswain as a point of balance
In the account of the race, the coxswain is not an accessory presence. The source attributes a series of precise responsibilities to this role: reading how the competition is unfolding, guiding the boat, giving instructions at decisive moments, and turning nine people into a single crew. These are different tasks, but they are linked by the same goal: holding the collective effort together.
This function explains why the recognition given to Martina Bonalumi concerns both her qualities and her rapport with her teammates. The ability to work as a team, emphasized by the mayor, does not erase individual talent. It places it within a performance in which each member contributes to the final result.
The second element indicated by Moro is its educational value. The success of the young local woman is seen as a message addressed to younger people: talent alone is not enough. Sacrifice, consistency, and a willingness to work together are also needed. The medal thus becomes the visible part of a journey built on perseverance and collaboration.
For the Dumenza community, the significance of the result is also measured by the opportunity to share the joy of the two podium finishes. The mayor emphasized that every time Martina steps onto a podium, she also carries with her a piece of the town. The local dimension does not replace the international one, but accompanies it: the performance remains that of the Italian eight, while the pride is shared by the entire community.
Read this way, the story is not merely the chronicle of two medals. It is the story of a sporting role that requires leadership and listening, of a crew that must move as one, and of a result that the town interprets as an example of collective work.

The third step concerns the local significance. The mayor's message links the sporting result to four elements: talent, sacrifice, perseverance and the ability to work as a team. These are the same elements that make it possible to understand the coxswain's role beyond the simple classification result. Guiding the boat means reading the race, giving instructions when necessary and keeping nine people together within a single crew.
Following these three steps avoids two partial interpretations. The first would be to consider only the individual recognition, forgetting the teammates in the eight. The second would be to stop at the placing, without grasping the educational value indicated by the mayor. Instead, the source offers a more complete perspective: two closely spaced podium finishes, a team performance and a message aimed at younger people.

item.title: Como, drug dealer arrested for home deliveries
item.description: The State Police of Como arrested a 48-year-old man: 51.45 grams of cocaine in 86 doses, 120 euros, and another 141.18 grams of cocaine seized.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - A 48-year-old man arrested in Como for possession with intent to distribute - Cocaine home deliveries in the city and outskirts confirmed - 86 doses of cocaine and 51.45 grams seized - Ordered to be held at Bassone di Como
## Key facts - Who → 48-year-old Italian citizen of Dominican origin - Operation → Mobile Squad of the Como State Police - Method → home deliveries using his own car - Personal and vehicle seizure → 51.45 grams in 86 doses - Money → 120 euros believed to be proceeds from drug dealing - Phones → 2, used to contact customers - Home search → approximately 4000 euros and 141.18 grams - Outcome → arrest in the act and transfer to Bassone di Como
### The operation in Como
The State Police of Como arrested a 48-year-old Italian citizen of Dominican origin, legally residing in Italy. The man was found in possession of numerous doses of cocaine and cash.
The intervention took place during an operation conducted by investigators from the Mobile Squad to combat itinerant drug dealing. The counter-drug activity covered the city and outskirts.
Investigators established several sales of narcotics attributed to the 48-year-old. According to the reconstruction, the man carried out the activity using his own car, making home deliveries for the benefit of some users.
The sales were established during the Mobile Squad's work as part of the operation against drug dealing. The method described by the Police thus includes the use of the car and home delivery, while the investigation led to the identification of the person involved and some users.
After verifying the sales, the officers proceeded to identify and search the 48-year-old and his vehicle. The operation records also included a home search. The checks therefore concerned the man, his car, and his home, following a sequence of checks that preceded the arrest in the act described in the records. ## Seizures uncovered during the checks
### The personal and vehicle search
The personal and vehicle search led to the seizure of 51.45 grams of cocaine, divided into 86 doses. The police also seized 120 euros in cash, considered proceeds from drug dealing, and two phones used by the 48-year-old to contact customers. These items were seized during the check of the drug dealer, together with the substance already divided into doses.
| Check | Outcome | |---|---| | Personal and vehicle | 51.45 grams of cocaine in 86 doses; 120 euros; 2 phones | | Residence | Approximately 4000 euros in banknotes of different denominations; an additional 141.18 grams of cocaine |
### The search of the residence
The search of the residence led to the seizure of approximately 4000 euros in banknotes of different denominations and an additional 141.18 grams of cocaine. The seizure carried out at the residence is listed separately from the 51.45 grams divided into 86 doses found during the personal and vehicle search.
The two phones were used by the 48-year-old to contact customers, while the 120 euros were considered proceeds from drug dealing. The search of the residence added both more cocaine and a sum in banknotes of different denominations. The description of the seizures therefore distinguishes the material recovered during the personal and vehicle search from that found at the residence, reporting separately the two quantities of cocaine indicated in the records. ## The judicial follow-up
### The Judicial Authority's decision
At the conclusion of the proceedings, the 48-year-old was arrested in flagrante delicto for possession of narcotic substances with intent to distribute. Following his arrest, he was placed at the disposal of the Judicial Authority. The authority ordered that the man be committed to Bassone Prison in Como.
The judicial stage comes after the identification and the personal, vehicle and home searches described in the operation. The charge brought against the 48-year-old remains possession of narcotic substances with intent to distribute, while the facility indicated for his commitment is Bassone Prison in Como.
For the recipients of the handovers, the subsequent course was different. Some were subsequently identified and administratively sanctioned. The sanction was imposed after investigators from the Mobile Squad established the handovers, in the operation against mobile drug dealing.
The concluding sequence described by the Police therefore comprises the arrest in flagrante delicto, being placed at the disposal of the Judicial Authority, and the order committing him to Bassone in Como. These are the measures indicated for the 48-year-old after the searches and the seizure of the cocaine, cash and phones.
The outcome for the other recipients, on the other hand, is identification followed by an administrative sanction. The case thus keeps separate the measure adopted against the 48-year-old and the one concerning the recipients of the handovers. For the man, the place indicated by the Judicial Authority is Bassone Prison in Como.
*Source: [comozero.it](https://comozero.it/attualita/como-arrestato-pusher-che-consegnava-a-domicilio/)*

item.description: Como, Local Police checks between 15 settembre and 2 ottobre 2026: 16 removal orders and 4 reports in the areas under enhanced protection.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Checks from 15 September to 2 October 2026 - 16 orders to leave issued - 4 foreign nationals referred to the judicial authorities - Crocifisso area and Giardini di viale Varese
## Key facts - Period → 15 September-2 October 2026 - Locations → Crocifisso area and Giardini di viale Varese - Orders → 16 orders to leave - Reports → 4 foreign nationals referred to the judicial authorities - Regulation → Urban Police Regulations - DACUR → 2 reports for failure to comply with measures issued by the Police Commissioner of Como
The period between 15 September and 2 October 2026 saw the Como Local Police engaged in targeted monitoring and prevention operations in the Crocifisso area and at the Giardini di viale Varese. The officers paid particular attention to the areas identified as enhanced-protection zones, as part of the activity focused on strengthening urban security.
The selection of the locations is linked, in the Local Police's communication, to the presence of urban decay and conduct contrary to regulatory provisions. The main outcome of the activity was the issuance of 16 orders to leave, issued following violations of the provisions set out in the Urban Police Regulations and committed in the areas covered by the specific protection measures.
During the checks, four foreign nationals were also referred to the judicial authorities. This figure is indicated as a further result of the operations carried out in the areas subject to enhanced protection and adds to the orders to leave adopted for violations of the urban regulations.
The account of the operation therefore provides the tally of a series of targeted operations: territorial monitoring covered two locations identified for enhanced protection, led to removal measures and resulted in referrals to the judicial authorities. The activity was carried out by the Como Local Police as part of urban prevention and security efforts. ## How the outcomes are divided
The balance of the checks includes two types of outcomes. On one hand, there are removal orders, linked to violations of the Urban Police Regulations in the areas affected by protection measures. On the other hand, there are referrals to the judicial authority, for which the source distinguishes two different reasons.
The distinction reported by the Local Police is as follows:
| Outcome | Detail | |---|---| | Removal orders | 16 measures following violations of the Urban Police Regulations | | Immigration legislation | 2 subjects reported for violations related to this matter | | DACUR | 2 subjects reported for non-compliance with measures issued by the Questore of Como |
The four referred individuals were of foreign nationality. Two cases were linked to violations of immigration legislation. The other two concern non-compliance with DACUR measures, an acronym for 'Divieto di Accesso alle Aree Urbane' (Ban on Access to Urban Areas), issued by the Questore of Como.
The reference to DACUR measures is therefore distinct from that relating to immigration legislation. In both cases, the Local Police communicated a referral to the judicial authority, while the removal orders derive from violations of the provisions provided by the urban regulation.
The Local Police place these results within the broader framework of urban security and territorial presence, implemented through targeted control and prevention services. The framework thus includes interventions in reinforced protection zones and the various outcomes produced during the same activity. ## The checks will continue
The Como Local Police has indicated that checks in the areas under enhanced protection will also continue in the coming weeks. This continuation is included in the Local Police's urban security service planning and forms part of the broader territorial monitoring deployment introduced through targeted control and prevention activities.
The continuation concerns the areas already identified for the specific protection measures. Reference therefore remains to the Crocifisso area and the Giardini di viale Varese, the same places where officers carried out operations between 15 settembre and 2 ottobre 2026. The communication links the continuity of the action to urban security planning.
For the coming weeks, the plan described keeps control of the areas under enhanced protection at its center. The stated objective remains the strengthening of urban security in areas affected by degradation phenomena and conduct contrary to regulatory provisions. The continuation confirms the ongoing nature of the services announced by the Local Police.
The checks carried out and the outcomes already recorded will be followed by further targeted operations. The Como Local Police will continue to operate within its urban security planning, with control and prevention activities in the areas designated as under enhanced protection. Territorial monitoring remains the framework indicated for upcoming interventions.

The club links the decision to its sporting strategy. In the club's explanation, the change is part of the choice to continue giving space and opportunities to young players. Kostner's position is included in this sporting approach.

For the 34-year-old from Bressanone, what comes next is already defined: his career will continue with Milano Hockey Club. ## The blue-and-white record ### Ten seasons in Leventina Kostner arrived in Leventina in the summer of 2016. From that moment, he wore the blue-and-white jersey for ten consecutive seasons, a period during which, according to the club, he became an important presence on and off the ice. The sporting record is reported through the National League figures. Wearing the Ambrì Piotta jersey, the center born in 1992 played a total of 432 games. Alongside the figures, the club highlights elements related to how Kostner carried out his role. The club cites his experience, his character and the way he interpreted the position. In Ambrì Piotta's assessment, these aspects represented a point of reference for the locker room.
The account of the ten years spent in Leventina therefore unfolds on two levels. The first is that of the games played in the National League, with 432 appearances overall. The sequence of data makes it possible to distinguish the different entries in the record: 432 games, 52 goals, 77 assists and 129 points. The total number of points is indicated by the club as the overall result of the goals and assists. The journey that began in the summer of 2016 is thus associated both with the continuity of the ten consecutive seasons and with the role played in the club's recent history.
For Ambrì Piotta, Kostner was not merely the center born in 1992 who appeared in the National League statistics. The club describes him as an important figure beyond the ice as well, highlighting his experience, character and interpretation of the role. This is the context with which the club accompanies the player's numerical record. ## The Sporting Decision and What Follows ### Space for Young Players The decision by Ambrì Piotta is framed by the club within a sporting strategy aimed at young players. The stated objective is to continue giving them space and opportunities, fostering their development and gradual integration into the first team. Kostner's departure is therefore linked to a decision about the future composition of the team.

The move does not change the immediacy of the departure, but clarifies the sporting direction associated with the decision: the position is brought back into the development path of the younger players.
For Kostner, on the other hand, what comes next is represented by Milano Hockey Club. The 34-year-old from Bressanone will continue his career there wearing the jersey of the newly founded club. The new destination is indicated together with his departure from Ambrì Piotta and constitutes the next chapter in the player's sporting career.
The club's text thus presents two related developments. The first concerns Kostner's transfer, as he leaves Ambrì Piotta with immediate effect. The second concerns the blue-and-white team's project, which intends to continue offering space to young players and fostering their gradual entry into the first team.
The position occupied by the player is the meeting point between the two decisions. On the one hand, a new next step is assigned to Kostner's career; on the other, Ambrì Piotta plans to entrust that position to a younger profile. The strategy indicated by the club thus accompanies the change of jersey without adding any further steps to the announced decision.
The immediate departure from Ambrì and the continuation at Milano Hockey Club close the blue-and-white phase and open the next one. For the Ticino club, the move is part of the continuity of the sporting project dedicated to young players. For Kostner, the news instead indicates the new team with which he will continue his career.
